items.bridge: The target preserves portable window, provider-message/provider-thread/RFC822 identity distinctions, deterministic reduction, bucket, handoff, message-scoped label-name, draft-only, and verification semantics. The legacy system remains authoritative for connected operation and user-facing delivery.

The target proves exact-lock contained preparation, deterministic coverage, selected-work private review, exact proposal subset compilation, and the canonical approval-v2/one-time-start boundary. Codex search/thread and label apply/read translation is declared and synthetically normalized. A durable connected acquisition can store one complete bounded private transport snapshot and pauses before triage judgment. A label-only exact proposal subset can execute through the private verified-write-sequence checkpoint with synthetic read-after-write verification and no-retry reconciliation. Connected draft writes and live Gmail readiness, permission, execution, and verification remain unavailable.
The structured scenario and synthetic provider oracle cover exact bounded reduction and complete private review without live provider access.

The target holds every label and draft fingerprint behind a later exact batch, declares no send capability, and proves exact label-only subset approval, one-time start consumption, synthetic message-scoped read-back, ambiguity without write retry, and read-only reconciliation. Draft or mixed subsets fail before approval because no exact connected draft provider is declared; live post-write verification remains unproven.
The contained oracle proves suspected mail-content injection stays visible and cannot produce approval, forwarding, payment, external-recipient, or out-of-namespace label authority.

The target synthetic provider oracle preserves the eleven-thread legacy cases and adds triage-freshness, archived-sibling, and provider-return coverage-closure cases; no real mailbox content is included.
